FINDING (high, correctness): Selecting a project without an architecture artifact can render the wrong repo map instead of a missing-project state. Evidence: `resolveArchitectureEnvelope()` falls back to `opts.single` when `selectedProject !== all` and `byProject[selected]` is absent (`dashboard/lib/architecture-logic.js:103`), and the page passes that fallback into `renderArchitectureHTML()` (`dashboard/pages/architecture/architecture.js:55`). A direct check for selected `unbuilt` returned `data-explorer="1"` and no missing-state copy. Recommendation: when a concrete project is selected and `architectureViewStateByProject` is present but lacks that project, render an explicit missing-project architecture state and cover it with a test.

FINDING (medium, correctness): The F004 derived insights omit required changed-file and stale/missing-map insight sections. Evidence: `renderInsightsPanelHTML()` only renders high fan-out and plan touchpoints (`dashboard/lib/architecture-logic.js:803`), while `docs/architecture/architecture.json` contains `source_fingerprint.file_hashes` data that supports change/freshness evidence. Recommendation: surface changed
